main.description: One entry on witness (witness.bisks.net), a plain-HTML public ledger for things a community wants on the record — a food-pantry receipt, a pothole complaint, whatever else. Any atproto account may write one; the site reads the network for every repo holding this collection (com.atproto.sync.listReposByCollection + Jetstream) and folds them into one public, no-login feed. `sourceUrl` links the original document wherever it's actually hosted (a mirror, a co-op server, anywhere but here); `photo` is an optional direct upload to the poster's own PDS for when there's nowhere else convenient to host a scan. Written and read by witness (https://witness.bisks.net).

category.description: What kind of thing is being witnessed. "receipt" for spending/financial records, "pothole" for a civic infrastructure complaint (tallied by location so repeat reports of the same spot count up), "other" for anything else worth a paper trail.

title.description: A short, plain-language summary — what this is, in one line.

body.description: Optional longer description: what happened, what it shows, why it matters.

amount.description: Optional free-text amount, mainly for a receipt (e.g. "$42.17"). Free text, not a parsed number, so any currency or notation works.

location.description: Optional free-text location — an address, cross streets, or landmark. Mainly for a pothole report: entries whose location text matches (after trimming case/punctuation) are tallied together as repeat reports of the same spot.

sourceUrl.description: Optional link to the original document — a scanned receipt, a photo, a PDF — hosted wherever the poster already has it. This site never mirrors or re-hosts it.

photo.description: Optional photo of the receipt, the pothole, or the document itself, uploaded straight to the poster's own PDS via com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob when there's nowhere else convenient to host it.

createdAt.description: When this entry was recorded, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
